$comment: Contract for the Katalon True Platform MCP server. Source: the live tools/list of the connected server, platform.katalon.io, captured 2026-10-20 (74 tools, schemas read from the connector, no tool called). Evidence: 04-projects/true-skills-modernize/evidence/P3/live-schemas.md and live-diff.txt in the vault. The earlier docs-page contract (71 tools, docs.katalon.com/katalon-platform/testops-mcp-server, October 2026) is superseded. A human re-diffs a live dump with: node scripts/check-mcp-live.mjs <tools-list.json>. Edit this file only through a reviewed change; scripts/validate-skills.mjs reads it.
source: Katalon True Platform MCP live tools/list, platform.katalon.io, captured 2026-10-20
countNote: All 74 live tool names are listed. The earlier docs-page contract had 71 names; 15 of them are not live and sit in retired, and 18 live tools were added (search, memory_*, fetch_*_metrics, update_test_run and others). Re-diffed 2026-10-20: check-mcp-live reports no missing and no new tools.
prefixNote: Skills name tools by bare name. MCP clients add a prefix: Claude Code uses mcp__<server>__<tool>, and mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool> for plugin servers.

classes.read: No side effect. Never needs confirmation. Pure payload builders (build_*) and polling tools are read.
classes.write: Changes workspace state. Preview, confirm once for the mutation set, execute, read back. Entries with destructiveWhen need an explicit yes naming the target for those actions. Entries with consent need confirmation because they consume TestCloud minutes, launch a hosted browser against a real AUT, queue generation, or can change AUT data. Entries with external reach a third party system (Jira, ADO) or consume TestCloud minutes.
classes.destructive: Removes or stops something. Needs an explicit yes that names the target.

tools.name: build_private_local_testing_config
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for private AUT access, mode tunnel or whitelist. MUST show the user the Select Tunnel form and wait for an explicit pick before tunnel mode. Creates nothing.

tools.name: build_run_configuration
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for automated.configurations. config_type is DESKTOP_AND_MOBILE_BROWSER, MOBILE_NATIVE or API, chosen from the requested environment, not the suite name. Copy os, os_version and browser fields from one list_test_cloud_environments row. MOBILE_NATIVE needs an uploaded app.

tools.name: build_schedule
tools.notes: Pure payload builder for the schedule object of create_test_run. Creates nothing. For a scheduled manual run, resolve the AUT with read_auts first.

tools.name: confirm_artifact_upload
tools.notes: Confirms a prepared upload with the exact artifact_id returned by prepare_artifact_upload and does not attach evidence. Then pass only {artifact_id} in update_test_results evidence. Repeat confirmation is safe.

tools.name: create_defect
tools.notes: Files a real Jira or ADO bug linked to one test result (project_id, alm_integration_id, alm_connection_id, test_result_id, payload.summary, payload.description). External side effect: preview and confirm first. Ask the user for the summary when missing; suggest the failed case name or "Defect for {test case name}". Description falls back to the result error message.

tools.name: create_manual_ai_session
tools.notes: Legacy and subset launcher for Run with AI. Prefer update_test_run START KATALON_AI. Never call it before or after a START on the same run. Ask the user for browser_profile_mode and os (windows or linux); never default them. Chrome on Windows or Linux only.

tools.name: create_test_case
tools.notes: Creates a MANUAL case. With test_case_type AUTOMATED it creates nothing and returns script guidance. Name starts with a letter or digit and allows spaces and ( ) . , _ -. path starts with Test Cases. Encode a shared-flow call as a step action {type call, test_case_id}, never as a plain step named Call test case.

tools.name: create_test_cloud_app
tools.notes: Registers an uploaded binary from storage_path. Skip it when the app was uploaded in the TestCloud web UI. Poll list_test_cloud_apps until the app is READY.

tools.name: create_test_run
tools.notes: Single run-creation tool. mode manual or automated, with the matching manual or automated object, an optional schedule and private_local_testing_configuration. Manual: call read_auts first, ask for AUT or skip, never guess os_version or browser_version. Automated: suites or collections only, test_run_type from build_run_configuration config_type, parallelize_test_cases only when the user asks. If the user did not say manual or automated, ask. Replaces create_manual_test_run and schedule_test_run.

tools.name: create_truetest_journey_map
tools.notes: Starts an async build job and returns a request_id. Report it as queued and poll get_truetest_journey_map_request. Do not resubmit automatically after a validation error, conflict, timeout or upstream error.

tools.name: create_truetest_test_case_from_flow
tools.notes: Queues test case generation for one flow (project_id, client_code, map_id, flow_id). STARTED means queued, not done; TERMINATE means no request was created. Existing cases follow the backend regeneration behavior. Read state with get_truetest_journey_map(flow_id).

tools.name: create_truetest_test_case_from_session
tools.notes: Queues generation from 1 to 25 session_references. Search sessions first and let the user pick; pass references unchanged. STARTED means queued, not done. Needs explicit user approval.

tools.name: delete_test_case
tools.notes: Deletes a case. Unreliable (HTTP 500 observed). Prefer update_test_cases (UPDATE_STATUS INACTIVE) or move_test_case.

tools.name: delete_test_cloud_app
tools.notes: Permanent. The tool text requires the user to type YES and to confirm when several apps match.

tools.name: duplicate_test_case
tools.notes: Copies a case in place.

tools.name: fetch_defect_metrics
tools.notes: Defect distribution by priority and severity. filter.filter_type ITERATION, DATE_RANGE or DEFAULT (last 28 days) is mandatory. resolution_state defaults to UNRESOLVED. Replaces get_defect_insights.

tools.name: fetch_defects
tools.notes: Defect linkage lookup. filter_type TEST_RESULT (test_result_ids), TEST_CASE (test_case_ids, optional execution_id), EXECUTION (execution_id). A result with an empty defects list has no linked defect.

tools.name: fetch_requirement_metrics
tools.notes: Requirement coverage statistics for a sprint or release (iteration_type, iteration_name). Check the iteration exists first. Replaces get_requirement_insights.

tools.name: fetch_test_case_metrics
tools.notes: Test case execution and automation statistics. filter.filter_type ITERATION, DATE_RANGE or DEFAULT (last 28 days). Replaces get_test_case_insights.

tools.name: fetch_test_configuration_metrics
tools.notes: OS and browser coverage and pass rate with coverage_threshold (0.8) and pass_threshold (0.95). configuration_type OS or BROWSER. Replaces get_test_configuration_insights.

tools.name: fetch_test_stability_metrics
tools.notes: Flaky, always-failing, new-failure and slow tests for an EXECUTION or an ITERATION, with from_date and to_date. return_tests (ALL, FLAKY, ALWAYS_FAIL, NEW_FAILURE, SLOW) returns case details; limit_tests defaults to 3 per category. Replaces analyze_test_case_stability and analyze_test_flakiness.

tools.name: find_execution_profiles
tools.notes: Execution profiles for a project and repository. Never assume or infer a profile; return the list and let the user choose. Feeds profile_id for automated runs.

tools.name: find_iterations
tools.notes: Sprints and releases. type Sprint, Release or All with scope CURRENT, PREVIOUS, NEXT, ACTIVE, LAST_N, RECENT, or a structured query.where. detail_level FULL returns dates and state.

tools.name: find_requirements
tools.notes: Synced Jira or ADO requirements. filter_type COMMON (status, id, assignee, createdBy, externalIssue.summary), RELATIVE (RECENT, NEW = last 7 days), ITERATION (iteration_type plus id or name).

tools.name: find_test_cases
tools.notes: Filtered list with light metadata. filter_type COMMON (folder with include_subfolders, query.where, featureAreas), RELATIVE (needs at least one criterion), ITERATION. Resolve folder_id with find_test_folders by full rawPath; folder scope is bounded to 200 folders and fails rather than truncating. automationStatus is not testType and not lifecycle status. Page with next_page_token. Relative filters returned HTTP 500 on one project (2026-08-03).

tools.name: find_test_cases_by_requirement
tools.notes: Reverse join from requirement to cases. Pass exactly one of requirement_id, key (ALM key) or requirement_external_id (externalIssueId). include_details adds description and preCondition.

tools.name: find_test_folders
tools.notes: Lists folders, paged by next_page_token. Filter by name for a known folder; name search includes nested folders, so compare rawPath to tell same-named folders apart.

tools.name: find_test_results
tools.notes: Results at four granularities (filter_type COMMON, RELATIVE, TEST_RESULT, EXECUTION). include_details adds error detail and failed assertions, not log content. Every row carries case and suite names. Replaces read_test_result and read_execution_test_results.

tools.name: find_test_suite_collections
tools.notes: Lists suite collections, or reads one by collection_id (returns testSuiteEntries, needed for a collection run). No create or edit tool exists.

tools.name: find_test_suites
tools.notes: Lists suites. COMMON (name partial or exact, query.where) or RELATIVE (RECENT, NEW, CREATED_BY_ME). First page is 0.

tools.name: get_truetest_journey_map
tools.notes: One map with independent paged cursors for pages, flows, steps and transitions. Never mutates. Copy flow_id values unchanged.

tools.name: get_truetest_journey_map_request
tools.notes: Polls a map build job by request_id and returns the map_id correlation. Do not guess by list order.

tools.name: get_truetest_session
tools.notes: Session metadata and replay steps from an unchanged session_reference. include_raw_events (default false) returns at most 100 events with field values NOT redacted: use only for explicit troubleshooting.

tools.name: get_upload_test_cloud_app_url
tools.notes: Presigned upload command and storage_path for an app binary. Then create_test_cloud_app, then poll list_test_cloud_apps until READY.

tools.name: list_alm_integrations
tools.notes: ALM integrations with integration and connection ids and, for Jira, the saved defect custom-field mappings. Feeds create_defect. Replaces find_alm_integration_projects.

tools.name: list_execution_outputs
tools.notes: TestCloud execution outputs. Without execution_id it lists the last 5 executions in 24 hours; with the TestCloud string id it lists every artifact and presigns one per call (videos first). Enumerate all outputs, never alter URLs.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.notes: Executions in a time window (default last 24 hours) and optional status. Returns numeric TestOps IDs and scheduling metadata only. Compute timestamps from the real current date.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.notes: Projects the signed-in user can access. Root of every chain.

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.notes: Repositories (Test Projects) in a project. repository_id gates the test case, suite, folder and profile tools.

tools.name: list_schedule
tools.notes: Saved schedules, filtered by name substring.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_agents
tools.notes: Execution agents in a project. Stop when page_token is null.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_apps
tools.notes: Uploaded apps. Quote values with spaces in rsql_filter. Use name, not appName. status NEW, UPLOADING, READY, ERROR.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_environments
tools.notes: Browser and device catalog. RSQL filter over platform, platformVersion, browser, browserVersion, device.deviceName and more. Include every user criterion. Page with page_token and next_offset until page_token is null.

tools.name: list_test_cloud_tunnels
tools.notes: Active tunnels in a project.

tools.name: list_truetest_auts
tools.notes: Linked TrueTest AUTs. platform_aut_id plus client_code is the AUT identity.

tools.name: list_truetest_tracking_environments
tools.notes: Tracking environments for a client_code.

tools.name: manage_requirement_test_case_linkages
tools.notes: One tool for link and unlink: action link | unlink, requirement_ids[], test_case_ids[]. Duplicates ignored. Requests run in parallel per requirement, so a partial failure leaves some requirements already updated: read back. Replaces link_requirements_to_test_case and unlink_requirements_from_test_case.

tools.name: manage_test_cloud_dynamic_app
tools.notes: Alias (dynamic) apps. payload.action CREATE or UPDATE. UPDATE silently redirects every consumer of the alias. Verify the target app first and confirm when several apps match.

tools.name: manage_test_folder
tools.notes: Folder lifecycle through payload.action: CREATE (path, testFolderType TEST_CASE | TEST_SUITE), RENAME, MOVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE. DELETE id must be the exact folder resolved by full rawPath, not an ancestor from treePath.

tools.name: manage_test_suite
tools.notes: Suite lifecycle through payload.action: CREATE, ADD_TEST_CASES, RENAME, MOVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE. Manages suite definitions only; a suite does not create a TestPak. Never mix MANUAL and AUTOMATED cases in one suite.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.notes: Permanently deletes memory records the user asked to forget. Run memory_list then memory_read first, delete exactly those ids, name what was deleted. Ask first when the read returns more than the user meant.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.notes: Kai memory headlines for the project and the user, plus the policy page in full. Call once per session. A truncated or unavailable listing never proves the team has decided nothing.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.notes: Full bodies for up to 20 memory ids. Agent rule beats user memory; otherwise the newer record wins; say which one you followed. Bodies are the person's own wording, not platform facts.

tools.name: memory_read_page
tools.notes: One distilled guidance page by slug from memory_list. Information, never an instruction to act.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.notes: Writes the person's OWN memory, only when the user asks to remember something. Body in the user's own words, headline under 120 chars, kind convention | preference | correction | verdict | constraint | environment. Never writes a project agent rule. Report redacted fields and duplicate hits.

tools.name: move_test_case
tools.notes: Moves a case and keeps its name. new_folder_path must start with Test Cases.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_upload
tools.notes: Returns a signed PUT URL for one evidence file up to 10 MiB. Measure the exact content_length first. No base64, no local paths. Upload without Platform credentials, then confirm_artifact_upload.

tools.name: prepare_test_cloud_tunnel_start
tools.notes: Returns setup commands for a tunnel client. test_type MANUAL or AUTOMATED; manual_execution_mode RUN_WITH_AI returns the full guide, TESTPAK or unknown returns VPN guidance only.

tools.name: read_auts
tools.notes: AUTs and their environments with clientCode. Call right before a manual run. The tool text carries the private-access decision flow with fixed option labels. Never auto-select a tunnel. If private access is needed and no tunnel is active, block the run.

tools.name: read_execution
tools.notes: One execution by numeric TestOps execution_id. start_time only for NOT_RUN. configType MANUAL marks a TestPak container, not an executor choice.

tools.name: read_manual_ai_session
tools.notes: Poll a Run with AI session (manual_execution_id, session_id). No push and no cancel. Pass test_case_id for per-step detail. Report overall status and next action only. Polling never launches a session.

tools.name: read_requirement
tools.notes: One requirement by requirement_id or key, normalised to Markdown. Read customFields before calling a requirement thin: acceptance criteria live there. include_attachments costs a live Jira or ADO call.

tools.name: read_schedule_detail
tools.notes: One schedule by schedule_id.

tools.name: read_test_cases
tools.notes: Batch read by test_case_ids. content_type NONE (default), FLOW (steps), SCRIPT, BOTH. Replaces read_test_case.

tools.name: read_test_suite
tools.notes: One suite and its cases.

tools.name: rerun_execution
tools.notes: Reruns an explicitly requested AUTOMATED execution, optionally limited by job_targets. Call read_execution first. An ID alone does not authorise a rerun. TestPak or manual runs use update_test_run START. No stop or cancel tool exists.

tools.name: search
tools.notes: Semantic search of the Knowledge Base: test cases, suites, folders, requirements and uploaded documents. Set include_documents false for an entities-only duplicate check. Tier, not score, decides exists. Empty, incomplete or keyword_fallback results never prove absence. Entity hits carry no steps: read them with read_test_cases. A requirement hit is context, not a coverage link.

tools.name: search_truetest_journey_maps
tools.notes: Lists journey maps by status, dates, tracking environment or creator_email.

tools.name: search_truetest_sessions
tools.notes: Captured sessions. Window at most 31 days. Returns an opaque session_reference that must never be constructed. Pass tracking_environment_id for attributes and replay URLs. Render columns UTC, Steps, Duration, Session ID, Custom attributes, Replay. email filter only when the user asks to find that session.

tools.name: stop_test_cloud_tunnel
tools.notes: Kills a shared tunnel. Other runs may depend on it.

tools.name: update_schedule_configuration
tools.notes: Partial-merge update. Call ONCE after the user confirms, with every target schedule in updates. Only explicitly requested settings. Never infer timeZone; ask for the IANA zone. startTime must be in the future. configType, testType and repositoryId change only with a full runConfigurationEntries replacement.

tools.name: update_test_cases
tools.notes: Batched editor: updates[] of {action, test_case_data}. Actions RENAME, UPDATE_STATUS, UPDATE_DESCRIPTION, UPDATE_PRECONDITION, UPDATE_PRIORITY, UPDATE_AUTOMATION_STATUS, UPDATE_CUSTOM_FIELD, UPDATE_ASSIGNEE, UPDATE_LINKED_TEST_CASES, REMOVE_LINKED_TEST_CASE, UPDATE_CONTENT. UPDATE_CONTENT replaces ALL steps, so send the full list and keep Call Test Case actions. Batch every change to one case in one call. Replaces update_test_case.

tools.name: update_test_results
tools.notes: Records a manual result (RECORD) or reviews an automated one (REVIEW). Case status never implies step statuses; steps is a partial update; all_steps_status only when the user reports all steps. Record observed outcomes only. The run must be active and created by the caller. Count only applied and unchanged outcomes as success.

tools.name: update_test_run
tools.notes: TestPak lifecycle: CONFIGURE (AUT and private access), START (MANUAL or KATALON_AI), END. Before START ask: Run With AI (recommended) or manual TestPak. No AI request does not mean MANUAL. KATALON_AI needs browser_profile_mode asked from the user. After a hosted START call read_manual_ai_session once. END with unfinished cases is rejected unless the user explicitly authorises SKIP.

retired.analyze_test_case_stability: fetch_test_stability_metrics with return_tests (ALL, FLAKY, ALWAYS_FAIL, NEW_FAILURE, SLOW) and filter_type EXECUTION or ITERATION
retired.analyze_test_flakiness: fetch_test_stability_metrics with return_tests FLAKY and a from_date and to_date window
retired.get_user_context: none: not exposed by the live server. There is no whoami tool; read the user from the client session, and ask the user for any assignee UUID
retired.read_manual_test_run_detail_by_order: none: the live server has no lookup by order number. Use list_executions to find the numeric execution_id, then read_execution
retired.update_test_case: update_test_cases with one action per field
retired.schedule_test_run: create_test_run with mode automated plus schedule from build_schedule
retired.search_external_tool_ops: none: absent from the live tools/list on 2026-10-20. Use the Jira, ADO, GitHub, Drive, Figma or Confluence connector directly
retired.run_external_skill: none: absent from the live tools/list on 2026-10-20. Do the tracker step through the tracker connector

unconfirmedNote: Names seen in an earlier capture or the server code but not in the live tools/list. Empty on 2026-10-20: every earlier unconfirmed name is now either live or in retired.
chatgptOnlyNote: Tools served by the ChatGPT app, not by the Katalon MCP server. They are absent from the live tools/list on purpose, so check-mcp-live.mjs excludes them from the missing, new and retired diff. Only files under chatgpt/ may name them.

chatgptOnly.name: settings_update
chatgptOnly.notes: Saves the default project, repository and AUT environment. Used by the get-started skill in ChatGPT only.

chatgptOnly.name: katalon_profile
chatgptOnly.notes: Returns the signed-in organization and account name. ChatGPT app only.

chatgptOnly.name: katalon_home
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: Katalon home view. ChatGPT app only.

chatgptOnly.name: plan_ai_run
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: Run with AI. The user's click starts the run.

chatgptOnly.name: plan_defect
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: defect draft. The user's click files it.

chatgptOnly.name: review_test_case_drafts
chatgptOnly.notes: Card: draft cases. The user's click saves them.

chatgptOnly.name: app_session_poll
chatgptOnly.notes: Card action that polls a Run with AI session.

nonTools.name: read_secrets
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no secrets tool.

nonTools.name: manage_test_data
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no test data tool.

nonTools.name: create_test_data
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no test data tool.

nonTools.name: manage_tags
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no tag tool.

nonTools.name: create_charter
nonTools.reason: Named in a not-available line: the MCP has no charter tool.

nonTools.name: schedule_id
nonTools.reason: Parameter of read_schedule_detail, not a tool.
